title: GELU Activation
hint: Exact: x * 0.5 * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2))). Or approximate: 0.5*x*(1+tanh(sqrt(2/pi)*(x+0.044715*x^3))).

description.text: Implement GELU (Gaussian Error Linear Unit): GELU(x) = x * Phi(x) = x * 0.5 * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2))), where Phi is the standard normal CDF.

examples.output: Smooth, nonlinear activations (0 at 0, positive for x > 0, negative for x < 0 but bounded).
examples.explanation: Matches the standard erf-based GELU used in many transformers.

constraints: Do not use F.gelu or nn.GELU.
Use torch.erf for the exact version.
